title: caltha polypetala var. orthorhyncha
intro: Caltha polypetala var. orthorhyncha, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Marigold are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Marigold include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
